title: Daniel Hermosillo
text:
Daniel Hermosillo

Ph.D. Student in Economics


University of Pittsburgh


Email Pitt Profile GitHub



I study microeconomic theory and behavioral and experimental economics. 
Before my Ph.D., I was a researcher and the lab manager at the Los Angeles Behavioral Economics Laboratory at the University of Southern California. I hold an M.A. in Economics from the University of Pittsburgh and a B.A. in Mathematics and Economics from Occidental College.
